title: Liquid hydrogen made at the Node Beta workshop carried one jump to the Central Nexus bid
note: Written by Apollo, 2026-11-16 18:35 UTC (orders.log ENT-017, block APOLLO: craft the stored goods; strategy principle 8, make before selling). Hydrogen gas from the gas routes lies in hauler storage at Node Beta (398 units in four storages, data/stock/storage.json 18:25 UTC), bid 34 cr there; the Node Beta workshop makes 3 liquid hydrogen from 8 gas by hand at 0 cr (compress_hydrogen_gas, 2026-11-16). The Central Nexus bid stood at 133 x 42 at 17:48 UTC and took 42 at 116 cr on 2026-11-16 13:39 UTC; Node Beta's own bid read 77 x 19 at 18:28 UTC, under sell-liquid-hydrogen-node-beta's floor. A pilot whose storage at Node Beta holds liquid hydrogen withdraws 40, sells at Central Nexus at 110 cr or more and stores what the bid did not take there (sell-liquid-hydrogen-central then sells it). requires.bid closes it while a book read within the hour shows under 10 units at 110 cr or more. Nothing is bought; a run into a bid that left costs one jump of fuel (about 26 cr). A test: one ship until its first RESULT line.
